user_request: 1.Hn标签等于H1到Hn原始累计收益之和，先做H20，不分档和10档。2.H7/H15做10档，与H20比较分风格，检验T减弱D增强是否普遍。
hypothesis: Summing within-horizon cumulative returns rewards earlier/persistent gains; may favor smoother paths but does not mathematically penalize volatility. Test predictive changes separately from this mechanism. Quantization may interact with label horizon and market style.

source_policy.labels: Nov3 frozen provider and original H7/H15/H20 labels; controls must match ordered inputs
source_policy.validation: Existing exit-bounded H5 valid and tradable, same as p50 trials
source_policy.inference: Formal DK_I on Nov3 provider; exact control prediction bridge
source_policy.v5_reference: Current v5 uses old H20 labels; compare against it as formal baseline, but scientific paired H20 controls use existing Nov3 continuous and q10 models. Do not attribute old/new differences to grading.

label_processing.base: Legacy H40-valid/listing-qualified base; each target keeps its own finite mask. Do not force an all-H intersection.
label_processing.sum: Float64 sum of 20 raw float32 cumulative returns, require every component finite; CSRankNorm (average daily pct rank-.5)*3.46 after target mask, before training-date selection.
label_processing.quantile10: Exact rational midpoint ranks; right-closed boundaries j/10; preserve ties; apply fixed v5 affine and no reranking

comparison_rule.H_ranking: Among H7/H15/H20, list all maximizers separately in each D/F/T for net_ann and Sharpe, before and after q10. Historical seven-H conclusions are context, not a new seven-H sweep.
comparison_rule.universal: For each H compute q10 minus same-source continuous. T deterioration requires all three net_ann differences < -1e-12; D improvement all three >1e-12. Report counts, every difference, Sharpe separately, and per-seed/year consistency. No claim beyond tested three H.
comparison_rule.path_sum: Compare sum20continuous vs original H20continuous, sum20q10 vs original H20q10, and within sum20 q10 vs continuous; separate returns/Sharpe/RankIC.
comparison_rule.mechanism: Train-only relation between path-sum rank and realized path volatility conditional on daily terminal-return deciles; illustrative equal-terminal paths to show no guaranteed lower-volatility preference. Descriptive, not a selection criterion.
comparison_rule.limitations: Historical selection window; F only136days/seven2024months; no independent OOS and no automatic promotion.

entry_policy: One model study entry; four internal candidates plus reused controls. Native parent lifecycle and actual fit ledger; supplementary candidate/report ledger maintains four distinct identities and scientific results. Representative sum20q10 predeclared, not selected winner.
implementation_steps: Verify control models/predictions/input hashes and provider version.
Materialize labels with finite-mask/quantile/formula tests; no outcome exposure.
Fit four fixed groups, five seeds each, sequential; capture every ES round/ties.
Formal annual DK_I inference, exact control bridge; canonical Top3H5 all/year/style and H5 RankIC.
Register every completed/failed candidate through one parent with individual receipts, rebuild reports before next group.
Review input/scientific claims, cleanup exact task-owned temporary data, official platform dry-run, native close.
